query_contract: Use the exact current corrected scripts/acquire_relational_environment_occurrences.py fetch_species implementation and unchanged Study-B relation rule. No occurrence-selection rule may change.
replacement_rule: For a species with REQUEST_ERROR, a later successful technical retry replaces only that species' REQUEST_ERROR ledger and occurrence rows. All non-REQUEST_ERROR species remain byte/semantically unchanged from the authoritative acquisition.
stopping_rule: If any REQUEST_ERROR remains after round 3, Study-B relation binding is forbidden and the state is INCOMPLETE_TECHNICAL_EXECUTION, not NOT_EVALUABLE_B.
forbidden: change year window, GBIF filters, page offsets, spatial thinning, cap, or minimum n
select a retry result based on R_env, taxonomy, or any genetic response
convert unresolved HTTP transport errors into ecological inadmissibility
